user_display_name.description: Only for device codes: the person the device would be added to.

owner_user_id.description: Person of the library the book belongs to.

borrower_user_id.description: A person of the library; the loan stores their current name.

name.description: 1 to 60 characters, unique in the library ignoring case and outer spaces.

color.description: One of the shelf colours; default `sage`.

has_cover.description: True when a cover can be taken from the file.

name.description: The name the file had when uploaded.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the content.

EbookMetadata.description: Metadata read from the file itself; every field may be missing.

ExportBook.description:
A book in the JSON export: `BookOut` without `placement` and `on_loan`,
plus the shelf name and the 0-based row and slot.

Facets.description: Counts over the whole library, whatever filter a list is using.

genres.description: Grouped ignoring Unicode case, showing the most frequent spelling; at most 200.

owners.description: People who own at least one book, most books first, then by name.

candidates.description: 1 to 8 image URLs, tried in order.

value.description: Genre as spelled most often; `null` for books without a genre.

content.description: The whole file as text, up to 10 MB.

row.description: Line of the file where the record starts.

ImportedBook.description: A normalized record read from an import file.

code.description: Clear-text code; shown only in this response.

unchanged.description: True when the requested `version` is the current one; `items` is then empty.

version.description: Opaque fingerprint (SHA-256, hex) of the entries.

on_loan.description: `true`: only books with an open loan; `false`: only the others.

owner_id.description: Books of this owner: a person id, `me` or `none` (no owner).

q.description: Full-text search over title, subtitle, authors, description, notes and ISBN.

room_id.description: Books placed on a shelf of this room.

oneOf.description: The person lent to, with their current name; `null` for a free-text borrower.

overdue.description: Open loan whose `due_at` is in the past.

sources.description: Providers that contributed at least one field.

room_id.description: Room of the library; absent or `null` means no room.

code.description: Clear-text code; shown only in this response.

PatchBook.description:
Body of `PATCH /books/{id}`: an absent field is left alone, `null` clears
an optional field (`title` cannot be cleared).

owner_user_id.description: Person of the library; `null` removes the owner.

PatchLoan.description:
Body of `PATCH /loans/{id}`: absent = unchanged, `null` clears `due_at` and
`notes`. `book_id` is accepted only to be rejected.

borrower_user_id.description: A person of the library (the stored name becomes theirs); `null` removes the link.

PatchWish.description:
Body of `PATCH /wishlist/{id}`: absent = unchanged, `null` clears an
optional field (`title` and `priority` cannot be null).

email.description: Only for admins and the owner, and only when the person has one.

last_seen.description: The most recent `last_seen` among the person's devices.

PersonRef.description: A person of the library as other records show them.

shift.description:
When true, books from `slot_index` onwards slide one slot right up to
the first free slot, atomically. Defaults to false. Requires `slot_index`.

slot_index.description:
Absent: the book goes to the slot after the last occupied one of the
row (0 when empty), or stays put if it is already on that row.

spine_width.description: 1–3 sets the width; absent keeps the current value; `null` clears it.

tag_ids.description: The full set of tags of the book; at most 20 distinct ids.

kind.description: Only `cfi` (the Bookeeper reader) can be written here.

value.description: The position in the format of the writer, at most 4000 characters.

average.description: One decimal; `null` when no book is rated.

Reader.description:
What the family sees of someone's reading: state and dates only. Rating,
note and current page stay private to their author.

ReadingFacet.description: Books of the library by the caller's reading state.

none.description: Books without a state for the caller.

total.description: Count with the same filter, ignoring `limit` and `offset`.

progress_percent.description: 0 to 100: the one progress of this person on this book.

years.description: Every year with at least one finished book, most recent first.

ReadingSummary.description: The caller's reading state as shown inside a book.

days.description: Only days with at least one finished book, oldest first.

display_name.description: Required (1 to 60 characters) when the code is an invite; ignored for a device code.

users_remapped.description: Archive users that do not exist in this library.

shelf_count.description: Shelves of the library placed in the room.

RoomSummary.description: A room as shown inside a shelf.

ServerOut.description: How clients can reach this server.

public_url.description: Always present in the JSON; `null` when there is no public address.

book_count.description: Number of books placed on the shelf.

oneOf.description: The room the shelf is in, if any.

room_id.description: Absent keeps the room; `null` removes it; an id moves the shelf there.
